description: EasyTier desktop manager (EasyTier 桌面管理器).
notes: EasyTier Manager needs administrator rights: every launch triggers a UAC prompt.
Start it from the Start menu shortcut, or run 'sudo easytier-manager' from a shell.
Settings live in %APPDATA%\com.ch3n4y.easytier-manager and are kept across 'scoop update'.

script: # The NSIS setup is unpacked rather than executed, so Scoop installs the app green:
# no uninstall registry entry, no installer bookkeeping. Tauri is a single
# self-contained binary, so the payload alone is all that is needed.
# The NSIS extractor leaves its own helpers and the uninstaller beside the payload.
if (!(Test-Path "$dir\easytier-manager.exe")) { error 'easytier-manager.exe not found after extraction' }
